positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.insights: Application Engineering, Software Infrastructure and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Development Internship
positions.description:
Work under the software architecture team to learn and develop the application development stack design and architecture.
Develop applications using Angular, Java, Spring Boot, NgRx, SQL, HTML, CSS and TypeScript. Testing of applications through JUnit 5 and Mockito to test code, ensure functionality and meet the necessary code coverage. 
Utilize various tools to analyze, deploy, facilitate and monitor applications such as UrbanCode, Jenkins, SonarQube and Kibana.
Participate in sprints on application development projects to implement features and progress towards completing an internal business application. Daily status meetings to communicate how to complete tasks, when to have them done by and to work alongside others. 
Utilization of Azure DevOps to access project sprint details such as tasks assigned, details, track progress and time spent, assign story points, submit pull requests and more.

positions.title: Continuous Improvement Intern
positions.description: Created process documentation for the implementation of a new WMS in a warehouse. Met with managers and directors to obtain pertinent information to the integration of systems.
